units.source_text: 姐姐——这个词是猝然脱口而出的。

en.t: Older sister -- the words burst from his mouth before he knew it.
It was his first time meeting her.

units.source_text: 再说，要同千代子结婚的事，他不但没有征求她双亲和姐姐的同意，甚至连告诉也没告诉一声。

en.t: Besides, as for marrying Chiyoko, he had not only failed to ask her parents and older sister for their consent, he had not even told them about it.

units.source_text: 然而，他却冒冒失失地靠近了千代子的姐姐。

en.t: And yet, he rashly approached Chiyoko's older sister.
